newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan steel, chemicals up as blue-chip rise pauses.
newsitem.headline: Japan steel, chemicals up as blue-chip rise pauses.

text.p: Japanese steel and chemical sector shares rose in Thursday morning trade as investors turned their attention away from blue chips, which are entering a correction phase, brokers said.
As of 0126 GMT, Kawasaki Steel Corp was one yen higher at 365. Mitsubishi Chemical Corp rose five yen to 393.
"While the outlook on currencies is unclear, it is difficult to keep buying high-tech shares which ascended on the back of the weakening yen," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
"Institutional investors are selecting domestic-demand-related issues which are backed by solid earnings and are not very volatile for their portfolios."
